description: MARIO builds and analyses input-output and supply-use models in Python. Politecnico di Milano, eNextGen and contributors provide parsers, matrix calculations, aggregation, table conversion, scenario shocks and result exports. Supported sources include EXIOBASE, EORA, Eurostat and other economic databases, with custom Excel, text, CSV and pandas inputs. Geographic coverage, accounting period and sector detail follow the selected tables. The software can support infrastructure supply-chain and economic interdependency simulations or environmental footprint scenarios. Source access is free under GPL-3.0, while input databases retain their own terms. MARIO complements the related model-pymrio library in the catalogue and provides table manipulation and shock calculations. A limitation is dependence on accounting consistency and the assumptions of input-output modelling. The current README supports Python 3.11 through 3.13 and excludes later versions because of a pinned dependency. No economic database was downloaded and no scenario was calculated.
name: MARIO input-output modelling suite
